lines.text: In this sharp-witted comedy, a minor zoning error spirals into
a full-blown town-wide feud—a kerfuffle!— complete with
bake sale sabotage, runaway goats, and a mayoral debate held
The movie delivers fast-paced laughs and small-town charm,
proving that bureaucracy can be hilariously unpredictable.
